name: awaiting-input
description: The engine asks a question it can't proceed without and ends its turn there. No live channel exists to inject an answer into a running adapter invocation (RunSpec is fixed at start()), so awaiting_input is immediately followed by run_ended{outcome:'needs_input'} — the answer arrives via a fresh run (RunTrigger 'resume'/'agent_message') composed with the answer in context, not a continuation of this stream.

event.text: I need to know which repository to target before I continue.

event.prompt: Which repository should I work in?
